Welcome to North Kidlington Primary School
Our childhood years are incredibly precious. Children need to be allowed to be curious and grow from the mistakes they make. Children need to be inspired to love the world they live in and to want to make a difference. Children deserve to have fun.
We want so much for our children: we want them to be happy and achieve their goals and dreams. We want them to enjoy learning because they are inspired and because they want to bring out the best in themselves.
Our curriculum is all about heart. All about enjoyment.
We understand the importance of our role as a school and have designed a unique curriculum that meets both the needs of the National Curriculum and those of the children. At North Kidlington we provide an exciting, thoughtful and ambitious education for all the children in our school.
Through varied learning experiences and practical activities, we aim to equip our children with the necessary knowledge, skills and learning behaviours that will support them throughout life. Key knowledge, concepts and core skills are embedded through a creative, meaningful and reflective curriculum that makes learning fun and forms purposeful connections between subjects, within our community and the world around us. All children are valued, nurtured and celebrated for their personal and collaborative achievements.
If you would like to find out more about the curriculum, please speak to your child’s teacher or make an appointment with the head teacher via the office.
Remote Learning Statement
North Kidlington School is ready to respond with remote learning should it be required.
Every child has work set on Google Classroom ready for a possible isolation. Some of the work may direct you to Purple Mash or to other websites such as BBC or Oak Academy however, Google Classroom will always be your first place to visit each morning to inform you of the day’s activities as we know lots of places to look can be confusing.
If you need help logging on, or you need support with the learning provided, please contact the office: 01865 372607 and we will do what is reasonably possible to assist.
Spelling Shed
Our children have been enjoying seeing which class can get the most points. We celebrate this, and individual efforts, in our assemblies. Click on the logo to see the current league results.

Governors
Governors of North Kidlington School Governors are responsible for ensuring that the school provides a good quality of education.
They help to plan the future direction of the school, make decisions on the school’s budget and staffing, and, along with the Head Teacher, set the school’s aims and policies. Governors include parents, representatives chosen by the local education authority, teachers, a non-teaching staff representative elected by their colleagues, and co-opted members who bring particular skills to the governing body. The Head Teacher usually elects to become a member of the school’s governing body. The Governors of each committee have the right to vote on behalf of the full Governing Body during individual committee meetings, however, any decisions which are made will always be brought back to the full Governing Body Meeting for finalising.
The governing body meets twice each term. Minutes of the meetings are posted on the school notice board as well as on this website. The minutes will be kept on the school website for a year. If you require minutes from meetings not listed, here please contact the school office. If you wish to contact any of the governors, you may do so via the School Office.
Our governing board is striving to represent the community we serve - if you would like to find out more about what being a governor entails or you would like to speak to someone about your views on North Kidlington School, please contact the school office and we will do our best to assist you.
